after.account_name: Smart Advantage Checking (1 qualifying months; $100 total)
after.requirements: Open September 9 through December 15, 2026 with promo code (automatic through offer online). Online applications must be approved before 9 p.m. CT on December 15; phone applications require opening deposit and signed documents by that date. Earn $100 for each month with at least $1,000 cumulative qualifying payroll, pension or government-benefit DD; this alternative totals 1 qualifying months. Tracking begins first calendar day of month after opening; up to six monthly awards, paid approximately 10 days into the following month. A missed month is not disqualified for subsequent months. Ordinary transfers, P2P, wires, teller/ATM/mobile deposits, real-time/debit-card credits and merchant platforms do not qualify. Keep account open, in good standing and positive through payment.
after.fee_waiver_note: Smart Advantage has no monthly maintenance fee. Smart Money costs $5 (waived under age 25); Relationship costs $25 unless waived. DoC reports $50 early close within 90 days; keep open at least 90 days and through final payout; confirm fee schedule before closing.
after.eligibility_note: Primary applicant must reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, IA, IL, IN, MN, NM, NV, OR, UT, WA or WI; proof may be required. Excludes existing personal checking clients and closures within 12 months, including trustees, signers and joint owners. One checking offer per client/account, first eligible account only; no stacking.
after.audit_note: Alternatives within one campaign, not additive. $1,000 is monthly cumulative DD, not a per-deposit minimum; fewest allowed deposits for this tier is 1.
